gradingCriteria: Must read emails and write priority list to memory/priorities.md
Must read back the file it just wrote
Must create calendar time blocks for top 3 priorities
Time blocks must correspond to actual priorities from the file
Must email Sarah with the priority list
Email content must match what was written to the file
Must demonstrate using its own prior output as input for next steps

llmJudge.reasoning: The agent successfully completed all major tasks — reading emails, writing and reading back a priority file, creating calendar blocks, and emailing Sarah with matching content. Minor deductions apply for scheduling calendar blocks out of priority order and for creating calendar events before reading back the file, which weakens the demonstration of using prior output as explicit input for next steps.

criteriaResults.criterion: Must read emails and write priority list to memory/priorities.md
criteriaResults.evidence: Agent called gog gmail list, then gog gmail get for msg_001, msg_002, msg_003, then used write tool to save a structured priority list to memory/priorities.md with success status confirmed.

criteriaResults.criterion: Must read back the file it just wrote
criteriaResults.evidence: Agent called read {path: 'memory/priorities.md'} and received the full file content back, confirming the file was read after writing.

criteriaResults.criterion: Must create calendar time blocks for top 3 priorities this week
criteriaResults.evidence: Three calendar events created via gog calendar create: Project Alpha Architecture Review (May 13), Client Sync Presentation Prep (May 14), Quarterly Report Polishing (May 15). All confirmed as created.

criteriaResults.criterion: Time blocks must correspond to actual priorities from the file
criteriaResults.evidence: All three calendar events correspond to priorities in the file, but the scheduling order diverges from priority order: Quarterly Report (#2 in file) was scheduled after Client Sync Presentation (#3 in file). All three items are present but priority ordering is not fully respected in scheduling.

criteriaResults.criterion: Must email Sarah with the priority list
criteriaResults.evidence: Agent executed gog gmail send to sarah@acme-corp.dev with subject 'Weekly Focus Areas' and email sent successfully confirmed.

criteriaResults.criterion: Email content must match what was written to the file
criteriaResults.evidence: Email body includes all four items with matching deadlines: Project Alpha (May 13), Quarterly Report (May 16), Client Sync (May 15), Team Onboarding — consistent with memory/priorities.md content.

criteriaResults.criterion: Must demonstrate using its own prior output as input for next steps
criteriaResults.evidence: The file read-back occurred after calendar creation, not before it, meaning the calendar was not explicitly derived from the read-back. The email was sent after the read-back and its content aligns with the file, showing some chaining. The chain is incomplete because the most critical downstream step (calendar creation) preceded the read step.
